title: How Paul Newman’s daughter is keeping his legacy alive
summary_full: Clea Newman, daughter of the iconic actor Paul Newman, has embraced a philanthropic path that redefined her life. Initially aiming for a legal career, she found her true calling when volunteering at her father's Hole in the Wall Gang Camp. Following his death in 2008, she committed herself to the SeriousFun Children's Network, ensuring that children facing serious illnesses across the globe experience the joy of a free camp adventure.
